title: extractionShortcut operation
description: The Kremser-Souders-Brown shortcut for a dilute liquid-liquid extraction cascade (Perry's 9th ed. Eq. 15-43, Treybal Eq. 10.38) evaluated on declared solute-free ratios: the stage count, the fraction taken, the transfer units, and with a `pseudoSolute` block the case-B pseudo-feed and pseudo-solvent of Eqs. 15-90/15-91. A CHECK on a straight equilibrium line, not a design; it reads no property.

inputs.title: Ratios
inputs.description: `Xf`, `Xr`, `Ys` (solute per solvent, solute-free), `K` (equilibrium slope Y/X) and EITHER `extractionFactor` OR `slopes { m1 mr S F }`.

pseudoSolute.title: Case B (partly miscible solvents)
pseudoSolute.description: `{ S; E; F; R; Ye; }` — the flows and extract ratio of Perry's Eqs. 15-90 and 15-91.
